method.direction: Lower is better within each memory metric. Sizes are bytes; requests are counts.
method.allocation_processes: Six fresh processes, three per library. Each process prepares all 14 workloads and captures them sequentially, one tracked call after ten warmups. Cyclic GC is collected after warmups and remains enabled during capture.
method.rss_processes: 42 fresh workers, three per library/workload, ten calls without Memray or preliminary warmups. GC is collected after preparation and remains enabled. RSS readings follow released results.
method.rss_units: Source KiB converted to bytes. Peak RSS includes imports, preparation, results, and retained allocator pages. No subtraction or reset.
method.zero_warmups: 18 fresh public-corpus workers. First library dumps call is tracked, including possible library initialization and first-use string allocations. It does not isolate UTF-8 caches.
method.warm_comparison_limits: The earlier ten-warmup public captures allowed concurrent builds/checks. These measurement families remain separate; there is no overall memory score.
